Answer: C
Reason: Comparing Figure 1 and Figure 2, there is a marked increase in the density and extent of pleural thickening/capping in the left upper zone, which now appears to contain a rounded opacity suggestive of a mycetoma (fungus ball) within a pre-existing cavity, a known complication of advanced sarcoidosis. The right side shows relatively stable apical changes, making option C the most accurate description of the progression.
